purpose: To file the statement containing salient features of financial statements referred to in the first proviso to sub-section (1) of section 136.
who: Not stated in the Rules text
when: Not stated in the Rules text
steps: Determine if the company is required to comply with Companies (Accounts) Rules, 2014, Rule 10.
Prepare the statement containing salient features of financial statements.
Use Form AOC-3 for the statement.
If the company is required to comply with Companies (Indian Accounting Standards) Rules, 2015, prepare and forward the statement in Form AOC-3A instead.
checklist: Applicability status of Companies (Indian Accounting Standards) Rules, 2015
watch: Ensure the correct form is used (Form AOC-3 or Form AOC-3A) based on the company's accounting standards applicability.
